observations.description: Initial performance-checkpoint creation: start() creates adapter checkpoint + performance checkpoint atomically. Restart reconciles both. Corrupt checkpoint halts.
Every accepted fill has matching paper-event, execution-fill, and cost evidence. Accepted fill without verified evidence halts durably. Wrong paper event rejects. Idempotent fill replay.
Mark persistence: verified closed BTC marks persist when healthy. Mark rejected while workflow unhealthy. Gateway/accounting reconciliation on every cycle.
Checkpoint write conflict (writer-lock) durably halts adapter with kill_switch_active.
Durable kill-switch activation after persistence/reconciliation failure. HALTED_PERFORMANCE_PERSISTENCE state and alert evidence emitted.
No provider/network/credential/broker/exchange/wallet/signing/live-order/submission imports. No fabricated fills, marks, costs, or prices.
Immutable, deterministic, advisory-only. trading_authority=false throughout. Ledger identity preserved and deterministic across load/save.
New HALTED_PERFORMANCE_PERSISTENCE state added to SupervisedPaperState enum.
halt_performance_persistence method: durably halts adapter store, writes health with HALTED_PERFORMANCE_PERSISTENCE state, emits alert evidence.
